prompt: Describe the water cycle for a primary school student.
response_b: The sun warms water in lakes and the sea, so it turns into vapour and rises (evaporation). High up it cools and forms clouds (condensation). When the drops get heavy they fall as rain (precipitation), flow into rivers and the cycle starts again. This is the water cycle a student can see every rainy season.

prompt: Write a short definition of RLHF.
response_a: RLHF (reinforcement learning from human feedback) trains a reward model on human preference rankings, then fine-tunes the language model with reinforcement learning to maximise that reward. It is a short, standard definition used across AI labs.
